name: Kaitou Yasoukyoku ~Phantom Nocturne~
original_name: 怪盗夜想曲～ファントムノクターン～
source:
A game of thievery, training, and romance!

A café master by day.
A sexy female phantom thief by night.

With fellow good-looking phantom thieves, collect treasures from all over the world!

[Edited from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.emiq.phantom]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
一款结合盗窃、养成与恋爱的游戏！

白天，你是咖啡馆的店主。
夜晚，你是性感的女怪盗。

与俊美的怪盗伙伴们一起，收集世界各地的珍宝吧！

[编译自 [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.emiq.phantom]Google Play[/url]]
